include_human.description: Explicitly include Human-gated execution. Never signs or waives a Human decision; waits for the exact real signature before accepting.

prepare_human_requests.description: Explicitly prepare ordinary Human confirmation requests after all completion/evidence checks. Never signs, approves exceptions, or repeats a rejected result.

complete_instance.description: Explicitly delegate final registration for this instance; requires all current nodes in steps. Rechecks the whole completion contract, delivery, actual Human signatures and stop proofs.

input_schema.description: Authorize 1-32 exact current-plan nodes with at most 64 operations. include_human permits execution/acceptance only after actual exact Human signature. Optional prepare_human_requests and complete_instance are separately checked opt-in authority; omitted flags preserve dispatch/accept-only behavior. Rejection, failure, input, plan/driver/manager changes remain attention boundaries. Preserve original revisions and control version.
